milestone: M12 External Mode Pack Execution Policy

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: External Mode Pack delegation now carries a bounded child policy snapshot identity across parent handoff and child execution.
Rust denies stale, missing, or malformed external Mode Pack child provenance before TaskRunning.
Controlled children materialized from external handoff envelopes preserve replay-safe provenance for explicit child runs.
Child TaskStarted and denial evidence carry bounded provenance metadata and policy fingerprints without raw Mode Pack content.
Headless callers can continue external Mode Pack child work without reimplementing snapshot freshness checks.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances mode_pack_runtime with supporting runtime_permission_enforcement, subtask_orchestration, persistent_structured_ledger, and headless_autonomous_development.
answers.new_capability: Controlled child task.run validates the external Mode Pack child policy snapshot provenance captured at materialization before recording TaskRunning.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M12.1 validates requested handoff target ids at parent admission, but child execution can otherwise depend on current Mode Pack state when no child ModeResolved snapshot exists.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: External Mode Pack child tasks would not be replay-safe across edits to .brownie/modepack.json between child materialization and child execution.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M11.2/M11.3 were headless continuation phases and M12.1 was target admission; M12.2 changes the child execution provenance boundary.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. Existing task.run and child materialization paths are extended without adding a method.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The phase adds bounded runtime evidence only, not a report/digest/history/readiness/preview surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: task.run rejects queued external Mode Pack children with stale, missing, or malformed provenance before TaskRunning.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Headless controllers can safely run delegated external child tasks after deterministic runtime provenance checks.
answers.milestone_progress: M12 gains the parent-to-child snapshot boundary needed for closeout assessment after handoff target admission.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M12.2 changes the deterministic current phase manifest. Review must confirm child task.run provenance behavior, not a wrapper or guard-only phase.

exit_criteria: Controlled children materialized from external Mode Pack parents receive bounded external_modepack_child_provenance evidence
Matching external Mode Pack child provenance allows explicit child task.run to continue
Changed .brownie/modepack.json child policy after materialization causes task.run rejection before TaskRunning
Missing or malformed external child provenance causes task.run rejection before TaskRunning
Repeated stale provenance attempts do not add TaskRunning or materialize duplicate children
Ledger and RPC evidence excludes raw Mode Pack JSON, raw prompts, provider responses, file content, stdout, stderr, commands, environment, secrets, request bodies, and absolute host paths
No new RPC, diagnostics wrapper, readiness report, digest, history, preview, or VSIX-owned policy path is added
next_phase_candidate_notes: M12 closeout after M12.2 if remote Mode Pack fetch/activation remains outside this milestone.
